title: Jayden Daniels addresses LSU squabble: "My sole personal focus is on Commanders' football"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jayden Daniels addresses LSU squabble: "My sole personal focus is on Commanders' football"
sources.description: The news that former LSU quarterback Jayden Daniels has told the school to stop using his name, image, and likeness after his No. 5 was reissued has made everyone involved look bad.
